senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) first. ר׳ ר׳ one after the other.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:13">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00059"><he>עָבַר</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:8">Gitt. V, 8</cite> <he>כהן קורא ר׳ וכ׳</he> a priest reads (from the Torah) the first, and after him &c.

<cite ref="Gittin 59b:9">Ib. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>לפתוח ר׳ ולברך ר׳ וליטול … ר׳</he> to be the first in opening a meeting, the first in saying the blessing &c., v. <cite ref="M01725"><he>מָנָה</he> I</cite>; a. v. fr.—Esp.

senses.gloss: ר׳ (or ר׳ לטומאה) first degree of uncleanness, original cause of uncleanness.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 2:2">Toh. II, 2</cite> <he>האוכל אוכל ר׳ ר׳</he> he who eats food of the first degree of uncleanness becomes himself unclean in the first degree.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 2:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>הר׳ שבחולין טמא ומטמא</he> secular food of the first degree of uncleanness is unclean and makes unclean.
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: ר׳ the person with whom a relationship begins, direct relative (brothers with reference to their respective issues).
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: ר׳ (כלי) a vessel direct from the fire.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:11">Yoma III, 11</cite> <he>על הר׳ נאמר וכ׳</he> to the former was applied the verse &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 112b:8">Sabb. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>אם ר׳ בני וכ׳</he> if those before us were sons of angels, we are sons of men, and if those before us were sons of men, we are &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 56b:10">Ib. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>מקיש ר׳ לאחרונים</he> the Scriptural text compares the predecessors to the successors.
Erub. 64ᵇ דורות הר׳ the earlier generations; a. fr.—Fem. רִאשׁוֹנָה.

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 11:12">Ned. XI, 12</cite> <he>בר׳ היו אומרים וכ׳</he> originally the law was that &c.; a. fr.—[Y. Taan. II, 65ᵃ top <he>בדִאשׁוֹנָהּ</he> on its (the year’s) first day (<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:2">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>בתחילתה</he>).]—Pl. <cite ref="T00034"><he>רִאשׁוֹנוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 34a:10">Ib. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳</he> (<cite ref="U01387"><he>שלש</he></cite>) the first three sections of the Prayer of Benedictions.
